sources.authority: Office for National Statistics / MHCLG Planning Data
sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 10 national parks from one provider; the collector last ran on 2026-06-26 and new data was last found on 2025-12-31.
sources.quality_effect: The boundaries are administrative/statistical national-park-authority boundaries and contain some MHCLG-created data, so they are an area-level constraint gate rather than an exact parcel decision boundary.

sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 94 registered battlefields from two providers; the collector last ran on 2026-07-21, new data was last found on 2025-02-12, and the origin is fully authoritative.
sources.quality_effect: A registered-battlefield intersection is an authoritative heritage constraint when an exact spatial relation is executed; it is not a positive future-growth signal.

sources.source: Planning Data historic parks and gardens dataset
sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 1,723 registered parks and gardens from one provider; the collector last ran on 2026-07-20 and new data was last found on 2026-07-18.
sources.quality_effect: Registered geometry and grade support heritage-constraint screening, but the mixed-origin warning requires current Historic England readback before a high-confidence parcel penalty.

sources.source: Planning Data archaeological priority area dataset
sources.authority: Historic England / Greater London Historic Environment Record
sources.verified_fact: The London-focused dataset lists 796 archaeological priority areas from one provider; the collector last ran on 2026-07-19, new data was last found on 2026-05-12, and the origin is fully authoritative.
sources.quality_effect: The four-tier archaeological-risk framework supports a London area-level constraint, but it does not establish development prohibition or parcel-level impact without exact relation and tier interpretation.

sources.source: Planning Data locally listed building dataset
sources.verified_fact: The experimental dataset lists 448 locally listed buildings from one provider; the collector last ran on 2026-07-18 and new data was last found on 2025-11-22.
sources.quality_effect: The service states the data was created by MHCLG and will be replaced by authoritative-source data, so it can only trigger further local-authority verification and cannot support a sole-source parcel score.

sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 382,250 listed-building records from two providers; the collector and new-data dates are 2026-07-21.
sources.quality_effect: The dataset explicitly supplies a point within each listed building and does not define the affected extent, so the point cannot be treated as a parcel polygon or curtilage boundary.

sources.source: Planning Data building preservation notice dataset
sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists nine building preservation notices from one provider; the collector last ran on 2026-07-21 and new data was last found on 2026-07-17.
sources.quality_effect: A notice creates immediate temporary listed-building-style protection, but the dataset is MHCLG-created and the notice is time-limited, so current notice status and authoritative documentation must be checked.

sources.source: Planning Data brownfield site geometry dataset
sources.verified_fact: The experimental dataset lists 2,916 brownfield-site geometries from five providers; the collector last ran on 2026-07-20 and new data was last found on 2025-12-19.
sources.quality_effect: The polygons can prepare spatial matching, but the service says the dataset is experimental and MHCLG-created; current authoritative brownfield-land records and canonical title parcels remain required before promotion.
